description: Surfaced by the specled_-vnw cold verifier (2026-07-24): lib/specled_ex/verifier.ex:2131 still names the streaming-attribution sidecar (specled_attr_*.jsonl / specled_pgkill_* etc.) with System.unique_integer([:positive]) — the same VM-local scheme specled_-vnw fixed for command temp scripts (shipped 0.5.2, PR #15, 699a503). Cross-VM collision here would corrupt/steal attribution events between concurrent specled runs sharing tmp_dir rather than exit-127 a command, so impact is subtler (misattributed per-test coverage) but the fix is identical: OS pid + random entropy. Audit all remaining System.unique_integer-based temp paths in lib/ while at it (test-only usages are fine). Likely advances specled.verification.

comments.text: In-the-wild datum (2026-07-24, specled_-epl ship preflight): a full spec.check produced a 266-finding anomaly — merged run exit 2 with EMPTY captured output plus mass tagged_tests_cover_not_executed warnings across many subjects; a serial re-run was clean. The empty output half is the (now-fixed) specled_-vnw class, but the cover_not_executed storm is consistent with THIS ticket's mechanism: run_merged_command names the attribution artifact specled_attr_<unique_integer>.jsonl in shared tmp; inner verifier_test tests running INSIDE the merged run create and File.rm their own specled_attr_* files with the same VM-local counter scheme, so a name collision deletes/truncates the outer run's attribution artifact mid-stream — exactly what mass cover_not_executed on a completed run looks like. This upgrades the ticket from 'theoretical collision' to 'plausibly observed'; the fix (pid+entropy, mirroring vnw and the 0.6.0 capture-log naming at verifier.ex preserve_failed_output) is mechanical. Raising P3→P2.
